== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns Elizabeth Glasgow. '''Elizabeth Glasgow''' died on 15 November 1893, aged 73; the death was registered in Londonderry, Ireland.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/death General Register Office for Northern Ireland (GRONI), civil death index], Elizabeth Glasgow, 15 November 1893, age 73, Londonderry registration district, D/1893/170/1020/14/497; indexed details supplied 23 September 2026.</ref>
She was born about 1820, as estimated from the reported age. The identification remains uncertain.
